Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital agency and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across: Digital Product Strategy & Innovation, Digital Marketing Services, Web & Mobile App Development, Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology Modernization.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

Our Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will operate remotely in Canada OR be based out of either our Toronto, ON or Vancouver, BC office locations.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital's Data, AI & Cloud (DAIC) practice is the multidisciplinary engine behind enterprise AI, blending boutique innovation with the breadth of a global services portfolio to help organizations architect, scale, and secure their transformations. Spanning our full family of specialized capabilities, the DAIC practice delivers end-to-end solutions across AI Advisory, AI Solutions, Data & AI Platforms, and Cloud Transformation.

As a premier Google Cloud partner, our Cloud practice is at the forefront of helping enterprises adopt and scale on Google Cloud infrastructure: delivering complex engineering, deployment, and migration programs for some of the largest organizations in Canada and beyond.

The Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will define and own the Data Engineering Practice along with its market positioning, P&L, talent, and the quality of work we deliver for clients. This role is for someone who has led data and AI practices before, understands how to turn messy enterprise data estates into strategic assets, and earns trust with C-suite executives through genuine expertise. You will shape how we help clients move from data ambition to durable, AI-ready infrastructure.

This Role Will Have Four Core Anchor Responsibilities

Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.
P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.
Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.
Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

Responsibilities

Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.
Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.
Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.
Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.
Drive investment in reusable IP, data accelerators, and delivery assets that improve consistency, reduce time-to-value, and protect margins at scale.
Serve as a strategic advisor to client C-suite executives, helping them define data strategy, navigate AI adoption, and build the organisational capabilities to sustain it.
Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.
Proven P&L ownership: Direct experience managing revenue, margin, and growth targets in a consulting or professional services context.
Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.
Executive communication: Able to advise, challenge, and build lasting trust with C-suite stakeholders on complex, ambiguous problems, not just present to them.
Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.
Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

About SandboxAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

About The Team

The SandboxAQ AI Generation Engine (SAIGE) team’s mission is to accelerate SandboxAQ’s mission of “Deep Impact at Scale”
with a focus on quantitative AI and rapid innovation. More specifically, the SAIGE team aims to:

Build next-generation AI capabilities that establish SandboxAQ as the global pacesetter in quantitative AI.
Identify, incubate, prototype, and launch new AI products for high-potential and longer-term use cases, proving (or disproving) their viability as high-impact, highly profitable business lines.

The SAIGE team operates on the following principles: Prototype with Velocity, Explore Boldly, Fail Smart, Learn Fast, Look Forward, and Share Knowledge.

Our current top priority use case is leveraging AI and LQMs to solve some of the most impactful problems in the Finance and Insurance industries.

The Opportunity

As The Director Of Product Management For The AI Generation Engine (SAIGE), You Will Be The PM Lead For The Team And a Key Partner To Engineering, Research, And User Research. You Will

Own the product strategy and execution for our efforts in Finance & Risk Modeling, partnering closely with financial services and insurance customers to understand their workflows, risk models, and decision-making processes.
Lead rapid prototyping and innovation across a broad range of new ideas and domains, driving 0→1 product discovery, experimentation, and incubation of high-potential use cases.
Operate in a highly ambiguous, fast-changing environment, providing clarity on priorities, making pragmatic trade-offs, and ensuring we ship impactful prototypes and products.

This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who is energized by uncertainty, enjoys working across disciplines (UXR, engineering, research, business), and is excited to build new AI and quantitative products from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

Lead product strategy in Finance & Risk Modeling

Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for our Finance/Risk portfolio, with a focus on financial services and insurance (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, risk analytics, underwriting, and related workflows).
Develop a deep understanding of customer contexts, including current tools, models, and data flows (e.g., portfolio / risk modeling systems, vendor platforms, internal analytics stacks).
Partner with quantitative researchers, ML engineers, and domain experts to translate customer problems into clear product requirements and model/data needs.
Define success metrics and validation strategies to compare our approaches against existing PML/ERM and portfolio views, and to demonstrate differentiated value.

Drive rapid prototyping and 0→1 innovation

Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new AI / LQM use cases across multiple domains (beyond Finance/Risk), from early signals to clearer opportunities.
Lead 0→1 product discovery: problem framing, hypothesis development, lightweight customer validation, and rapid iteration on prototypes.
Work with engineering and research to scope experiments that are small enough to move quickly but meaningful enough to answer key questions.
Establish and champion a rigorous but pragmatic approach to ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team focuses on the highest-impact opportunities.

Build strong customer and stakeholder relationships

Serve as a trusted product partner to senior stakeholders at key customers (e.g., heads of risk, portfolio managers, actuaries, CROs), speaking credibly about risk models, scenarios, and portfolio decisions.
Lead customer conversations from initial discovery through pilot definition and ongoing adoption, connecting customer needs to the SAIGE roadmap.
Communicate progress, learnings, and recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, including executives.

Essential Skills & Experience

You are a senior product leader who is comfortable at the intersection of AI, quantitative modeling, and financial risk
. You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy working closely with deeply technical teams, and can just as easily go deep on models and data as you can on customer needs and business outcomes. You are proactive, low-ego, and collaborative, and you don’t need rigid structure to have impact.

10+ years of product management experience, with substantial time spent on complex B2B or platform products; at least several years operating at a senior / staff / principal / director level (e.g., L7-equivalent scope).
Deep Experience in financial services and/or insurance, especially in one or more of:
Risk modeling (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, asset-liability management, market/credit risk, or insurance risk)
Financial simulation or scenario analysis
Portfolio analytics or decision support tools

Demonstrated ability to work closely with quantitative and engineering teams:
Past experience in building AI / ML products or capabilities
Comfortable discussing models, data pipelines, and trade-offs with engineers and researchers.
Able to translate between technical details and customer/business value.

Proven track record of 0→1 product work:
Identifying new opportunities and shaping them from idea to prototype and early product.
Working through high ambiguity, incomplete information, and changing constraints.

Strong ruthless prioritization skills: can define clear frameworks, make hard trade-offs, and say “no” to good ideas to focus on the best ones.
Exceptional customer-facing skills:
Confident leading discovery and roadmap conversations with senior stakeholders.
Skilled at uncovering real needs behind stated requirements and pressure-testing problem statements.

Demonstrated ability to drive execution without heavy process or structure:
Self-directed, proactive, and comfortable creating structure where needed rather than waiting for it.
Experience in environments with shifting priorities and evolving strategies.

Strong collaboration and communication:
Experience working tightly with UXR, design, engineering, and research.
Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

Alignment with SandboxAQ values and the SAIGE principles around rapid prototyping, learning, and shared ownership.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

Direct experience building products involving AI / ML, foundational models, quantitative models, or LLM/agentic systems.
Hands-on exposure to risk tools and vendor platforms (e.g., risk engines, portfolio analytics systems, or modeling platforms used in insurance and financial services).
Experience in both:
A high-growth startup or new product incubation context, and
A large, complex environment (e.g., Big Tech, major financial institution), giving you a strong sense of how to navigate stakeholders and scale impact.

Educational background in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, finance, or similar).

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping the future of quantitative AI, building products with real impact in finance and insurance (and possibly other domains), and leading 0→1 innovation in a highly cross-functional team, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.
Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.
Career Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

Technical Solutions is the technical arm of Gorgias for our biggest merchants. The team covers the full enterprise lifecycle with 2 groups of Solutions Engineers: pre-sales Solutions Engineers, who partner with Account Executives to win complex Enterprise and Named deals, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who embed with our highest-value merchants after signature to deploy, integrate and scale our AI Agent. The team is distributed across North America, Europe and Latin America, and works hand in hand with Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Finance.

Our biggest merchants bring complex tech stacks, custom order systems, multi-store setups and high expectations. This team closes the gap between what they need and what works in production.

About The Role

As our Head of Technical Solutions
, you will own the technical side of Gorgias for enterprise merchants, from the first demo to production. You will lead both the pre-sales and post-sales Solutions Engineering teams, make sure what we sell is what we can deliver, and turn forward deployed engineering into a scalable, profitable professional services business. You will own the P&L of professional services, including pricing and gross margin.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the COO. You will scope deals, build prototypes, review code and sit in customer Slack channels next to your team, especially in your first months. The perfect fit is an AI builder and a commercial operator in one person: someone who has already led a comparable transformation, turns constraints into an execution plan, and is as credible with an enterprise COO as with their engineers.

What You’ll Do

Lead and build the team

Lead, hire and coach a distributed team of pre-sales Solutions Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical quality, customer judgment and speed, and give direct, useful feedback.
Stay hands-on. Lead discovery on key deals, build proofs of concept, review architectures and code, and jump into debugging when a deployment is at risk.
Build the operating cadence: OKRs, capacity planning, engagement reviews and dashboards that show the team’s impact on revenue, automation and retention.

Win enterprise deals (pre-sales)

Own the technical win on Enterprise and Named deals. Partner with Account Executives on discovery, technical qualification, tailored demos, proofs of concept and solution design.
Help close. Build mutual close plans with Sales, map technical stakeholders and success criteria, and handle technical objections, security reviews, integration reviews and RFP responses.
Drive enterprise win rate and deal velocity. Make Solutions Engineer coverage on every qualifying deal, pipeline hygiene and win and loss reviews standard practice.
Make sure what we sell is what we can deliver. Timelines are realistic, scope is written down before signature, and trials or proofs of concept that behave like production deployments get the same rigor.

Deploy and scale our AI Agent (post-sales)

Define and productize standard deployment offers: packaged Forward Deployed Engineering engagements with clear scope, hours, deliverables and success measures, so most merchants can buy a standard package instead of a bespoke project.
Lead custom deployments for our most complex merchants: custom actions, integrations with order, warehouse and ERP systems, multi-store rollouts and bespoke builds, designed against real customer APIs.
Own the handoff from pre-sales to post-sales. Once a deal is scoped, one technical owner carries the action plan and delivery, with clear rules of engagement with Implementation Managers and CSMs so the customer never sees a gap.
Decide where capacity goes. Set eligibility rules for new and existing customers, and balance new deployments against re-optimizing existing accounts based on revenue, churn risk and automation upside.
Drive measurable outcomes on covered accounts: higher AI Agent automation rate, faster time to value, shorter custom action cycle time, and lower churn and contraction, with no drop in CSAT or resolution quality.

Run professional services as a business

Own the P&L of professional services: bookings, revenue, cost of delivery, utilization and gross margin. Set the targets and hit them.
Own pricing and packaging with Finance, Sales and RevOps: rate card, fixed price packages, statements of work and priced change requests. Protect margin by pushing back on waived fees and silent scope creep.
Enable the sales team. Train Account Executives to position, qualify, scope and sell professional services, and build the playbooks, pitch materials and qualification criteria they need. Partner with Product Marketing to take offers to market.
Enable the broader CX organization. Make Implementation Managers and CSMs self-sufficient on standard configurations, basic custom actions and first-line troubleshooting, so engineers stay focused on complex builds.

Build leverage

Productize the field. Every custom build has to make the next deployment cheaper: when we solve something for one merchant, it becomes a template, a reusable action, a playbook or a product update for the next 10. Track custom work per deployment and drive it down every quarter.
Automate the team’s own work. Use AI coding tools, agents and evals to speed up discovery, scoping, configuration, QA and reporting, so impact grows faster than headcount.
Be the voice of the enterprise merchant in Product and Engineering. Turn field signals into clear, prioritized requests and help shape the roadmap.
Represent Gorgias with leaders at enterprise brands, from strategy conversations to technical deep dives.

Who You Are

10+ years in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, professional services or technical consulting, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
5+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, ideally both pre-sales and post-sales, with a record of hiring and growing strong engineers and managers.
A proven pre-sales leader. You have helped win complex six and seven figure enterprise deals, and you know how to run technical discovery, proofs of concept and mutual close plans alongside Sales.
A professional services operator. You have owned a services P&L or a large part of it: you have priced and packaged services, managed utilization and gross margin, and turned custom work into standard offers.
A transformation leader. You have taken a reactive technical team and built a scalable, productized deployment motion, and you show up with a plan rather than a list of blockers.
An AI builder. You have shipped LLM-powered agents, workflows or integrations into production and know how to test them with evals and real data. You can show us something you built recently.
Technical enough to do the work. You can write and review code in Python or JavaScript and TypeScript, and work with REST APIs, webhooks and SQL.
Commercially sharp. You connect technical work to revenue, retention and margin, and you can say no to scope that does not make sense.
Calm and clear with customers. As comfortable presenting to an enterprise COO as debugging with their engineers.
Energized by ambiguity. You like building a function, and you write down how it works so others can run it.

Nice to have

Ecommerce or CX tech experience: Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, helpdesks, OMS or WMS platforms.
Experience at an AI customer service company or with conversational AI.
Experience leading teams across North America, Europe and Latin America.

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

Cosmetic Physician Partners (CPP) is the largest practitioner-owned medical aesthetics network in the US. Founded in 2022, we have grown to 80+ clinics across the US. We are profitable, have already returned more than $60M to our investors, and are majority owned by our doctors, nurses and employees. No private equity.

Our model is simple: great practitioners lead their clinics, and CPP gives them the leadership team, support services and brand to grow faster than they could alone. We are looking for leaders who want to help write the next chapter.

MISSION

Own CPP’s marketing strategy and make it happen in every clinic. Set CPP clinics apart in the minds of consumers so our network grows faster than our peers, and do it in a way that our physicians, practice managers and marketing team trust and get behind.

THE ONE THING THAT MATTERS MOST

CPP owns its clinics, but we treat our physicians and practice managers like owners. This person earns their trust and the trust of our marketing team. Trust is earned by showing up with a sharp strategy, knowing digital inside out, rolling up your sleeves to deliver results, and building a team people want to be part of.

KEY OUTCOMES

1. Earn the trust of our physicians and practice managers

Partner, not vendor:
Build real working relationships with physicians and practice managers, and treat them like the owners they act as. Understand each clinic’s goals, patients and local market before recommending anything.
Speak their language:
Translate marketing into what clinics care about: new patients, rebooking, revenue per provider and return on spend. Explain the why behind every plan in plain terms.
Show up:
Visit clinics regularly, run clear monthly performance reviews and follow through on every commitment. Bad news early, good news with data.
Clinic-level guidance:
Give clinics practical playbooks they can run locally, and coach practice managers who are less familiar with marketing.

2. Earn the trust of our marketing team

Lead by example:
Be the person who can do the work, not just review it. Credibility comes from walking the talk.
Clear direction:
Set clear priorities, targets and ownership so everyone knows what winning looks like and how their work moves the numbers.
Back your people:
Remove roadblocks, give honest feedback, and give credit generously. Build a fun, drama-free team culture aligned with CPP values.

3. Clinic-level marketing strategy

Local brand positioning:
For each clinic, define how it stands out in its local market: who its patients are, what it is known for, and how it beats local competitors.
Clinic marketing plans:
Build a marketing plan for every clinic with the channels, budget and targets it needs to grow, created together with its physicians and practice manager.
Local presence:
Grow each clinic’s reputation in its community through reviews, local search, social media, events and referral partners.
Growth levers:
Drive both new patient acquisition and retention of existing patients (rebooking, visit frequency, loyalty) clinic by clinic.
Network advantage:
Use CPP’s scale, shared playbooks and annual promotional calendar to make every local brand stronger, and decide where in-house beats agencies.

4. Lead our digital marketing team

Lead digital experts:
Lead a team of digital marketing professionals across paid media, SEO, web, CRM and design. Know the craft deeply enough to coach and challenge each of them.
Set clear goals:
Set goals and targets for each person and channel, tied to clinic results like new patients and rebooking, and review progress with the team regularly.
Clear the path:
Help the team work through challenges, from underperforming campaigns to tech and data issues, and make the call when trade-offs are needed.
Translate digital:
Explain what is happening in plain language to physicians, practice managers and business operators: what we did, what it delivered and what comes next. No jargon.
Measurement:
Make sure tracking and dashboards are in place so results are clear and trusted by everyone.
AI in marketing:
Keep building AI into our marketing stack, from content and creative to targeting, reporting and patient journeys. Test new tools fast and scale what works.

5. Hands-on execution

Walk the talk:
Personally build campaigns, review ad accounts, write briefs and fix what is broken. This is a player-coach role.
Ship fast:
Launch, measure, learn and adjust quickly. Deliver results in months, not quarters.
Roll out at scale:
Take what works in one clinic and roll it out across the network, including new and acquired clinics.
Best practices:
Benchmark top-performing clinics and standardize what drives results.

6. Build and support teams

Build the team:
Hire, develop and retain a high-performance team of employees and contract partners.
Develop people:
Coach team members to grow in their roles, with regular 1-on-1s, clear goals and honest feedback.
Manage partners:
Hold agencies and vendors to clear targets, and bring work in-house where it makes sense.

WHAT YOU BRING

Experience:
10+ years in marketing, with 5+ years leading teams. Healthcare, medical aesthetics or wellness a strong plus.
Nice to have:
Multi-location consumer services experience, and agency-side experience.
Relationship skills:
A track record of earning the trust of operators, owners or clinicians who do not report to you, and getting them on board with change.
Strategic and digital depth:
Proven ability to build a marketing strategy and personally run digital channels to measurable growth.
Hands-on mindset:
Comfortable going from a board-level plan to the details of an ad account in the same day.
Data-driven:
Fluent with marketing analytics and comfortable making decisions from numbers, while staying close to people.
Communication:
Clear, simple and direct in writing and in person. French is a plus but not required.
Adaptable:
Thrives on change. Our business moves fast and priorities shift, and you adjust quickly without losing momentum.
AI-forward:
Excited about AI and already using it in your own work. You see it as a way to do more, faster and better.
CRM agnostic:
Experience with any major CRM or marketing automation platform. We care about results, not tools.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

Trusted by clinics:
Physicians and practice managers see you as a partner and ask for your input.
Trusted by the team:
The marketing team is engaged, clear on its targets and retaining its best people.
Clear plan:
A network-wide marketing strategy and budget is in place and understood by clinics.
Measurable growth:
New patient growth and patient retention are tracked monthly and trending ahead of target.

WHY JOIN CPP

Compensation:
Competitive package including health and dental benefits, and free medical aesthetic services from our network.
Equity:
Significant equity upside as we grow.
Fast growth:
Build alongside a proven leadership team in a profitable, fast-growing business.

Very clear goals on what success looks like.
Culture:
We are clinic first, with a strong culture that values its people. A fun, drama-free workplace that rewards those who help build it.

Aller à la rencontre des restaurateurs, remonter des demandes individuelles aux problèmes fondamentaux qu'elles révèlent et challenger les hypothèses, les leurs comme les nôtres.

CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (CFO)

Bujou Group | Founding Executive Opportunity

Location: Calgary, Alberta
Employment Type: Full-Time | Executive Leadership
Compensation: Competitive Executive Salary + Equity Participation
Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

About Bujou Group

Bujou Group is a diversified Canadian business group operating across real estate development, investment management, construction, hospitality, property management, and marketing.

Through our portfolio of companies, including Precedent Developments, Bujou Capital, Bujou Construction Management, Bujou Properties, and Bujou Studios, we are building an integrated platform focused on creating, managing, and growing long-term enterprise value.

We are entering a significant stage of expansion with the launch of the Bujou Mutual Fund Trust (MFT), an investment platform initially offering two funds focused on strategic real estate equity investments and mezzanine lending.

As we establish this investment platform and continue expanding our operating businesses, we are seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join our executive leadership team.

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to take on a founding executive role in the launch and growth of Bujou Capital’s investment platform, while assuming financial leadership across the entire Bujou Group.

The CFO will be responsible for the financial strategy, management, reporting, and oversight of all Bujou Group companies, with a particular emphasis on establishing and managing the financial operations of the Bujou Mutual Fund Trust and its underlying investment structures.

The successful candidate will play a central role in launching our two initial investment funds, establishing institutional-quality financial infrastructure, supporting capital formation, and positioning the group for significant long-term growth.

We are seeking more than a traditional corporate finance executive. Our ideal candidate has experience operating at the C-suite level within an investment firm, asset management company, private equity platform, real estate investment firm, or capital markets organization.

As an early member of the executive leadership team, the CFO will have meaningful influence over the financial structure and growth of the organization, with equity-based compensation providing an opportunity to participate in the long-term value being created.

Key Responsibilities

1. Bujou Mutual Fund Trust & Investment Management

This will be the most significant and strategically important component of the role.

* Lead the establishment and ongoing financial management of the Bujou Mutual Fund Trust and its two initial investment funds.
* Oversee fund accounting, financial reporting, cash management, capital deployment tracking, and investment performance reporting.
* Establish appropriate financial systems and reporting processes across the MFT, Master Limited Partnership, and underlying investment entities.
* Manage net asset value calculations, investment valuations, investor capital accounts, distributions, and financial reconciliations.
* Develop and maintain fund-level financial models, cash flow projections, liquidity forecasts, and performance reporting.
* Coordinate with external fund administrators, auditors, tax professionals, legal counsel, and regulatory advisors.
* Establish financial controls, reporting standards, and governance procedures appropriate for a growing investment management platform.
* Support fund capitalization, investor due diligence, financial disclosures, and capital-raising initiatives.
* Ensure financial and operational reporting obligations are met in coordination with legal and regulatory advisors.

2. Group-Wide Financial Leadership

* Assume executive responsibility for financial management across all Bujou Group companies and subsidiaries.
* Oversee corporate accounting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, tax planning, and financial reporting.
* Develop consolidated financial statements and group-wide financial performance reporting.
* Manage intercompany transactions, capital allocation, and financial structures across operating entities.
* Establish financial controls and reporting systems that support operational efficiency and scalable growth.
* Provide strategic financial guidance to the CEO and executive leadership team.
* Oversee banking relationships, credit facilities, debt management, and corporate liquidity.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, capital efficiency, and long-term enterprise value.

3. Capital Markets & Corporate Finance

* Support the development and execution of Bujou Group’s long-term capital strategy.
* Work alongside executive leadership to structure financing arrangements, investment transactions, and strategic partnerships.
* Develop sophisticated financial models for acquisitions, developments, investment opportunities, and corporate transactions.
* Support institutional and accredited investor due diligence, financial presentations, and investment reporting.
* Evaluate debt and equity financing alternatives to optimize capital structures across the group.
* Build relationships with financial institutions, investment partners, lenders, and professional advisors.
* Support future investment fund launches and the expansion of the Bujou Capital investment platform.

4. Real Estate Investment & Development Finance

* Oversee financial analysis and reporting for real estate development, acquisition, and investment projects.
* Evaluate project feasibility, projected returns, financing structures, cash flows, and investment performance.
* Monitor development budgets, construction financing, loan covenants, and project-level financial exposure.
* Support investment decision-making through comprehensive financial analysis and risk assessment.
* Work with the executive team to establish consistent financial reporting across the real estate portfolio.

5. Executive Leadership & Organizational Growth

* Help establish the financial infrastructure required to support Bujou Group’s evolution into a sophisticated investment and operating platform.
* Build and lead internal finance and accounting teams as the organization expands.
* Establish relationships with external accountants, auditors, fund administrators, and other financial service providers.
* Participate in executive-level strategic planning, corporate structuring, and growth initiatives.
* Contribute to the development of new investment products, funds, and operating businesses.

Qualifications & Experience

Preferred Experience

* Previous experience as a CFO, VP Finance, Head of Finance, or senior financial executive within an investment firm, private equity firm, asset management company, real estate investment platform, or capital markets organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing investment funds, pooled investment vehicles, limited partnerships, or similar investment structures.
* Strong understanding of fund accounting, investment valuations, capital structures, investor distributions, and financial reporting.
* Experience supporting capital raises, investment transactions, and institutional or accredited investor relationships.
* Knowledge of Canadian investment fund structures, taxation, and applicable securities regulatory requirements.
* Experience with real estate investment, development finance, private credit, or alternative investments is highly advantageous.

Professional Qualifications

* CPA designation strongly preferred.
* CFA designation, MBA, or equivalent advanced financial qualifications considered a significant asset.
* Typically 10+ years of progressive financial leadership experience, including senior management or executive responsibility.
* Advanced financial modelling, forecasting, and analytical capabilities.
* Experience establishing and scaling financial operations within growing or entrepreneurial organizations.
* Strong financial governance, risk management, and strategic decision-making capabilities.

The Ideal Candidate

We are seeking a financially sophisticated executive who combines institutional investment experience with an entrepreneurial mindset.

The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at both the strategic and operational levels—developing capital strategies and advising on multimillion-dollar transactions while also taking ownership of the financial systems, controls, and reporting required to support a growing organization.

They will recognize the opportunity to help establish a new investment platform from its inception and will be motivated by the prospect of building a long-term business rather than simply managing an existing finance department.

Experience in capital markets or investment management at the executive level will be a significant differentiator.

Compensation & Long-Term Opportunity

We recognize that attracting an experienced financial executive requires an opportunity that reflects both the responsibilities of the position and the value they will contribute to the organization.

The compensation package will include:

* Competitive executive base salary, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
* Equity-based compensation, providing participation in the long-term growth and success of the business, subject to an agreed structure.
* Opportunity to become a founding member of the leadership team responsible for establishing Bujou Capital’s investment platform.
* Significant influence over the financial strategy, corporate structure, and future expansion of Bujou Group.
* A long-term executive leadership opportunity within a growing, diversified Canadian business group.

The specific compensation and equity structure will be negotiated based on the successful candidate’s experience, qualifications, and expected contribution.

Why Join Bujou Group?

Bujou Group is at an important inflection point.

With established operating businesses and the launch of our mutual fund trust and initial investment funds, we are creating a platform designed to connect real estate investment, development expertise, and long-term capital management.

For the right executive, this position represents an opportunity to help build the financial foundation of an investment business from its earliest stages, contribute directly to its growth, and participate in the value created along the way.

We are looking for a CFO who wants to help build an investment firm, not simply manage its finances.

How to Apply

Qualified candidates are invited to submit their résumé and a brief introduction outlining their executive financial leadership experience, particularly within investment management, private equity, capital markets, or real estate investment.

All applications will be handled confidentially.

À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS

Power Factors est un fournisseur de logiciels et de solutions qui mène la nouvelle génération de l'énergie propre avec Unity, l'une des suites de gestion de l'énergie renouvelable (REMS) les plus complètes et les plus largement déployées sur le marché. Avec plus de 300 GW d'actifs éoliens, solaires et de stockage d'énergie gérés dans le monde, plus de 600 clients et 18 000 sites, Power Factors gère 25 % des données mondiales sur les énergies renouvelables.*

Unity REMS de Power Factors couvre l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de l'énergie, de la supervision et du contrôle à l'analyse des marchés. Cette suite d'applications ouvertes, fondées sur les données, permet aux acteurs des énergies renouvelables de collaborer, d'automatiser les flux de travail critiques et de prendre des décisions plus éclairées afin de maximiser le rendement de leurs actifs. Les acteurs du secteur bénéficient d'un accompagnement de bout en bout, avec des solutions pour le SCADA et le PPC, la supervision centralisée, la gestion de la performance, la gestion commerciale des actifs et la gestion des interventions sur le terrain.

Grâce à sa vaste expertise métier, Power Factors propose à grande échelle des analyses issues de l'IA, afin que les entreprises puissent optimiser leurs actifs, libérer leur croissance et prendre de meilleures décisions alors que le monde accélère sa transition vers une énergie propre. Power Factors lutte contre le changement climatique par le code.

Hors Chine et Inde

À PROPOS DU POSTE

Power Factors est une entreprise de logiciels de référence dans son secteur, au service de l'industrie des énergies renouvelables. Nous recrutons un Directeur des Produits (Chief Product Officer, CPO) chargé de piloter la stratégie, les processus et la performance produit sur l'ensemble de notre portefeuille, et de transformer la gestion de produit en un véritable modèle de responsabilité (« ownership »).

Notre ambition est que chaque produit soit dirigé par un product owner qui comprend le chiffre d'affaires qu'il génère, le coût de sa conception et de son exploitation, ainsi que le rendement qu'il apporte. Le CPO développera cette capacité, inspirera l'équipe pour qu'elle l'adopte et sera responsable des résultats. Il s'agit d'un engagement pluriannuel pour façonner le prochain chapitre de l'entreprise.

Un partenariat essentiel

Le CPO et le Directeur de la Technologie (CTO) sont les deux moitiés d'un même moteur. Le CPO est responsable de ce que nous construisons et pourquoi : stratégie, valeur client, priorisation, résultats commerciaux et compte de résultat (P&L) des produits. Le CTO est responsable de la manière dont les produits sont construits et livrés : ingénierie, architecture et exécution du développement. Le succès repose sur des objectifs partagés, une confiance mutuelle et un rythme opérationnel commun qui transforme la stratégie en produits livrés, adoptés et rentables. Les candidats doivent démontrer une expérience avérée de partenariats exceptionnels avec des responsables technologiques.

Vos missions

Piloter la stratégie produit. Définir et communiquer une vision claire, centrée sur le client, ainsi qu'une feuille de route pluriannuelle qui renforce notre leadership dans les énergies renouvelables
Bâtir une culture de product ownership. Faire évoluer l'organisation vers une responsabilité produit assumée, chaque owner étant responsable des résultats, et non des seules livraisons
Mettre en place un suivi du P&L. Collaborer avec la Finance pour offrir à chaque product owner une visibilité transparente sur le chiffre d'affaires, la marge et la structure de coûts, et prendre sur cette base les décisions d'investissement, de tarification et d'arrêt de produits
Promouvoir l'excellence en gestion de produit. Instaurer des processus rigoureux et évolutifs pour la découverte, la priorisation, l'élaboration des feuilles de route, le lancement et la gestion du cycle de vie, avec des indicateurs clairs
Travailler en partenariat avec le CTO. Co-construire le modèle opérationnel, le calendrier de planification et les droits de décision entre produit et développement, et arbitrer conjointement les compromis
Collaborer avec l'ensemble de la chaîne commerciale. S'aligner avec les Ventes, le Marketing, le Succès Client et les Services sur le positionnement, le packaging, la tarification, l'adoption et la fidélisation
Rester proche des clients et du marché. Échanger avec les propriétaires, exploitants, gestionnaires d'actifs et investisseurs ; suivre la réglementation, la technologie et la concurrence ; identifier des opportunités de croissance, y compris des partenariats et des fusions-acquisitions
Développer les leaders. Recruter, accompagner et fidéliser une organisation produit performante ainsi qu'un vivier de futurs dirigeants
Contribuer en tant que dirigeant. Siéger au comité exécutif (ELT), participer à la définition de la stratégie de l'entreprise et rendre compte de la performance produit au PDG et au Conseil d'administration

Votre profil

Maîtrise fonctionnelle

Contributions démontrées et vérifiables en tant que responsable produit senior : produits que vous avez conçus, développés à grande échelle, repositionnés ou redressés, et résultats commerciaux obtenus
Capacité avérée à concevoir et à faire fonctionner des processus de gestion de produit, et à renforcer les compétences et l'esprit d'ownership d'une équipe
Aisance commerciale : expérience de la responsabilité ou de l'influence sur le P&L d'un produit, la tarification et le packaging, et prise de décisions d'investissement fondées sur les données
Historique de partenariats solides et collaboratifs avec la direction de l'ingénierie
Excellentes qualités de communication, capacité à inspirer, à influencer et à responsabiliser

Expertise du secteur des énergies renouvelables

Connaissance approfondie du secteur des énergies renouvelables, par exemple en matière de performance des actifs, d'exploitation, de finance ou de logiciels pour l'énergie. Nous étudierons aussi les profils de dirigeants produit exceptionnels capables d'apprendre rapidement, mais une expertise sectorielle approfondie est un véritable atout

Exposition au Conseil d'administration (souhaitée, non obligatoire)

Expérience préalable au sein d'un comité exécutif et auprès d'un Conseil d'administration. Nous accueillons volontiers les leaders en devenir dont le parcours et la motivation montrent qu'ils sont prêts à franchir cette étape

Qui vous êtes

Un expert de votre métier, avec un impact avéré et l'humilité de continuer à apprendre
Animé par l'envie de faire la différence et motivé par la mission d'accélérer la transition vers les énergies renouvelables
Enthousiaste à l'idée de rejoindre un leader de sa catégorie et prêt à vous engager sur le long terme
Un bâtisseur et un pédagogue, qui fait grandir son entourage

Comment le succès sera mesuré

Des product owners disposant d'une visibilité claire sur le P&L et assumant leur responsabilité sur l'ensemble du portefeuille
Un processus de gestion de produit mature et appliqué de manière cohérente
Une croissance mesurable du chiffre d'affaires produit, de l'adoption, de la fidélisation et de la marge
Un partenariat de grande confiance et à haute vélocité avec le CTO, ainsi qu'une équipe produit engagée et fidélisée

LA VIE CHEZ POWER FACTORS

Nous sommes une entreprise de développement logiciel agile : assez grande pour avoir un impact, assez petite pour aller vite et exécuter dans un secteur en pleine croissance. Nous sommes une équipe de talents audacieux et ingénieux, animés par les résultats. Nous sommes passionnés par l'idée de rendre le monde meilleur. Nous recherchons des personnes ambitieuses et humbles pour nous aider à réaliser notre plan.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE

En rejoignant l'équipe de Power Factors, vous ferez partie d'un groupe dynamique de personnes innovantes et motivées, engagées à avoir un impact positif. Chaque jour, votre travail contribuera directement à l'avancement des solutions d'énergie propre et au soutien des initiatives mondiales de durabilité. Notre culture est profondément ancrée et se reflète dans notre façon de travailler ensemble : engagés, consciencieux et collaboratifs. Avec de nombreuses opportunités d'évolution professionnelle, Power Factors vous accompagne dans votre développement alors que nous menons la transformation du secteur de l'énergie.

EMPLOYEUR GARANTISSANT L'ÉGALITÉ DES CHANCES

Power Factors est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, engagé à rassembler une main-d'œuvre diversifiée et à entretenir une culture inclusive. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront examinées sans considération de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, d'origine nationale, de handicap ou de statut d'ancien combattant.

About Power Factors

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world's renewable energy data.*

Power Factors' Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company's suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

Outside China and India

About The Role

PowerFactors is a category-leading software company serving the renewable energy industry. We are hiring a Chief Product Officer to own product strategy, process and performance across our portfolio, and to transform product management into a true ownership model.

Our ambition is for every product to be run by a product owner who understands the revenue it generates, the cost to build and serve it, and the return it delivers. The CPO will build that capability, inspire the team to embrace it, and be accountable for the results. This is a multi-year commitment to shape the company's next chapter.

The Critical Partnership

The CPO and Chief Technology Officer are two halves of one engine. The CPO owns what we build and why: strategy, customer value, prioritization, commercial outcomes and product P&L. The CTO owns how it is built and delivered: engineering, architecture and development execution. Success depends on shared goals, mutual trust, and a joint operating rhythm that turns strategy into shipped, adopted, profitable product. Candidates should show a track record of exceptional partnership with technology leaders.

What You Will Do

Lead product strategy. Define and communicate a clear, customer-driven vision and multi-year roadmap that extends our leadership in renewables
Build a product-owner culture. Evolve the organization from to accountable product ownership, with each owner responsible for outcomes, not outputs
Establish P&L oversight. Partner with Finance to give every product owner transparent visibility of revenue, margin and cost structure, and to make investment, pricing and sunset decisions on that basis
Drive product management excellence. Institute disciplined, scalable processes for discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, launch, and lifecycle management, with clear metrics
Partner with the CTO. Co-create the operating model, planning cadence and decision rights

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

About The Team

The SandboxAQ AI Generation Engine (SAIGE) team’s mission is to accelerate SandboxAQ’s mission of “Deep Impact at Scale”
with a focus on quantitative AI and rapid innovation. More specifically, the SAIGE team aims to:

Build next-generation AI capabilities that establish SandboxAQ as the global pacesetter in quantitative AI.
Identify, incubate, prototype, and launch new AI products for high-potential and longer-term use cases, proving (or disproving) their viability as high-impact, highly profitable business lines.

The SAIGE team operates on the following principles: Prototype with Velocity, Explore Boldly, Fail Smart, Learn Fast, Look Forward, and Share Knowledge.

Our current top priority use case is leveraging AI and LQMs to solve some of the most impactful problems in the Finance and Insurance industries.

The Opportunity

As The Director Of Product Management For The AI Generation Engine (SAIGE), You Will Be The PM Lead For The Team And a Key Partner To Engineering, Research, And User Research. You Will

Own the product strategy and execution for our efforts in Finance & Risk Modeling, partnering closely with financial services and insurance customers to understand their workflows, risk models, and decision-making processes.
Lead rapid prototyping and innovation across a broad range of new ideas and domains, driving 0→1 product discovery, experimentation, and incubation of high-potential use cases.
Operate in a highly ambiguous, fast-changing environment, providing clarity on priorities, making pragmatic trade-offs, and ensuring we ship impactful prototypes and products.

This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who is energized by uncertainty, enjoys working across disciplines (UXR, engineering, research, business), and is excited to build new AI and quantitative products from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

Lead product strategy in Finance & Risk Modeling

Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for our Finance/Risk portfolio, with a focus on financial services and insurance (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, risk analytics, underwriting, and related workflows).
Develop a deep understanding of customer contexts, including current tools, models, and data flows (e.g., portfolio / risk modeling systems, vendor platforms, internal analytics stacks).
Partner with quantitative researchers, ML engineers, and domain experts to translate customer problems into clear product requirements and model/data needs.
Define success metrics and validation strategies to compare our approaches against existing PML/ERM and portfolio views, and to demonstrate differentiated value.

Drive rapid prototyping and 0→1 innovation

Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new AI / LQM use cases across multiple domains (beyond Finance/Risk), from early signals to clearer opportunities.
Lead 0→1 product discovery: problem framing, hypothesis development, lightweight customer validation, and rapid iteration on prototypes.
Work with engineering and research to scope experiments that are small enough to move quickly but meaningful enough to answer key questions.
Establish and champion a rigorous but pragmatic approach to ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team focuses on the highest-impact opportunities.

Build strong customer and stakeholder relationships

Serve as a trusted product partner to senior stakeholders at key customers (e.g., heads of risk, portfolio managers, actuaries, CROs), speaking credibly about risk models, scenarios, and portfolio decisions.
Lead customer conversations from initial discovery through pilot definition and ongoing adoption, connecting customer needs to the SAIGE roadmap.
Communicate progress, learnings, and recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, including executives.

Essential Skills & Experience

You are a senior product leader who is comfortable at the intersection of AI, quantitative modeling, and financial risk
. You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy working closely with deeply technical teams, and can just as easily go deep on models and data as you can on customer needs and business outcomes. You are proactive, low-ego, and collaborative, and you don’t need rigid structure to have impact.

10+ years of product management experience, with substantial time spent on complex B2B or platform products; at least several years operating at a senior / staff / principal / director level (e.g., L7-equivalent scope).
Deep Experience in financial services and/or insurance, especially in one or more of:
Risk modeling (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, asset-liability management, market/credit risk, or insurance risk)
Financial simulation or scenario analysis
Portfolio analytics or decision support tools

Demonstrated ability to work closely with quantitative and engineering teams:
Past experience in building AI / ML products or capabilities
Comfortable discussing models, data pipelines, and trade-offs with engineers and researchers.
Able to translate between technical details and customer/business value.

Proven track record of 0→1 product work:
Identifying new opportunities and shaping them from idea to prototype and early product.
Working through high ambiguity, incomplete information, and changing constraints.

Strong ruthless prioritization skills: can define clear frameworks, make hard trade-offs, and say “no” to good ideas to focus on the best ones.
Exceptional customer-facing skills:
Confident leading discovery and roadmap conversations with senior stakeholders.
Skilled at uncovering real needs behind stated requirements and pressure-testing problem statements.

Demonstrated ability to drive execution without heavy process or structure:
Self-directed, proactive, and comfortable creating structure where needed rather than waiting for it.
Experience in environments with shifting priorities and evolving strategies.

Strong collaboration and communication:
Experience working tightly with UXR, design, engineering, and research.
Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

Alignment with SandboxAQ values and the SAIGE principles around rapid prototyping, learning, and shared ownership.

Highly Desired Skills & Experience

Direct experience building products involving AI / ML, foundational models, quantitative models, or LLM/agentic systems.
Hands-on exposure to risk tools and vendor platforms (e.g., risk engines, portfolio analytics systems, or modeling platforms used in insurance and financial services).
Experience in both:
A high-growth startup or new product incubation context, and
A large, complex environment (e.g., Big Tech, major financial institution), giving you a strong sense of how to navigate stakeholders and scale impact.

Educational background in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, finance, or similar).

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping the future of quantitative AI, building products with real impact in finance and insurance (and possibly other domains), and leading 0→1 innovation in a highly cross-functional team, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Join Us?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.
Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.
Career Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.

SandboxAQ Welcomes All

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity
: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

• Architecture Strategy: Leads the development and evolution of enterprise target architectures, standards, platforms and tools across the organization, ensuring alignment with business strategy and the established standards of parent organizations.

• Advisory Role: Acts as the senior architecture advisor to executive leadership and technical teams, facilitating the selection among architectural options to best meet business needs using existing, emerging, and strategically aligned technologies.

Qualifications:
• Education: University degree in a technology discipline.
• Experience: 12+ years of progressive information technology experience, with demonstrated expertise across multiple systems environments and architecture domains.
• Significant experience in enterprise architecture, technology strategy, or senior architecture leadership roles within complex organizations.
• Business / Strategy Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of the IT organization’s operational and strategic goals and objectives, with the ability to translate them into enterprise architecture direction.
• Project / Change Leadership: Strong project and change leadership skills, with the ability to influence priorities and outcomes across multiple stakeholders.
• Learning / Innovation: Demonstrated aptitude for continuous learning, strategic thinking, and innovation.

• Communication: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical teams and executive audiences, and with an exceptional client service orientation.

new_jobs.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

Technical Solutions is the technical arm of Gorgias for our biggest merchants. The team covers the full enterprise lifecycle with 2 groups of Solutions Engineers: pre-sales Solutions Engineers, who partner with Account Executives to win complex Enterprise and Named deals, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who embed with our highest-value merchants after signature to deploy, integrate and scale our AI Agent. The team is distributed across North America, Europe and Latin America, and works hand in hand with Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Finance.

Our biggest merchants bring complex tech stacks, custom order systems, multi-store setups and high expectations. This team closes the gap between what they need and what works in production.

About The Role

As our Head of Technical Solutions
, you will own the technical side of Gorgias for enterprise merchants, from the first demo to production. You will lead both the pre-sales and post-sales Solutions Engineering teams, make sure what we sell is what we can deliver, and turn forward deployed engineering into a scalable, profitable professional services business. You will own the P&L of professional services, including pricing and gross margin.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the COO. You will scope deals, build prototypes, review code and sit in customer Slack channels next to your team, especially in your first months. The perfect fit is an AI builder and a commercial operator in one person: someone who has already led a comparable transformation, turns constraints into an execution plan, and is as credible with an enterprise COO as with their engineers.

What You’ll Do

Lead and build the team

Lead, hire and coach a distributed team of pre-sales Solutions Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical quality, customer judgment and speed, and give direct, useful feedback.
Stay hands-on. Lead discovery on key deals, build proofs of concept, review architectures and code, and jump into debugging when a deployment is at risk.
Build the operating cadence: OKRs, capacity planning, engagement reviews and dashboards that show the team’s impact on revenue, automation and retention.

Win enterprise deals (pre-sales)

Own the technical win on Enterprise and Named deals. Partner with Account Executives on discovery, technical qualification, tailored demos, proofs of concept and solution design.
Help close. Build mutual close plans with Sales, map technical stakeholders and success criteria, and handle technical objections, security reviews, integration reviews and RFP responses.
Drive enterprise win rate and deal velocity. Make Solutions Engineer coverage on every qualifying deal, pipeline hygiene and win and loss reviews standard practice.
Make sure what we sell is what we can deliver. Timelines are realistic, scope is written down before signature, and trials or proofs of concept that behave like production deployments get the same rigor.

Deploy and scale our AI Agent (post-sales)

Define and productize standard deployment offers: packaged Forward Deployed Engineering engagements with clear scope, hours, deliverables and success measures, so most merchants can buy a standard package instead of a bespoke project.
Lead custom deployments for our most complex merchants: custom actions, integrations with order, warehouse and ERP systems, multi-store rollouts and bespoke builds, designed against real customer APIs.
Own the handoff from pre-sales to post-sales. Once a deal is scoped, one technical owner carries the action plan and delivery, with clear rules of engagement with Implementation Managers and CSMs so the customer never sees a gap.
Decide where capacity goes. Set eligibility rules for new and existing customers, and balance new deployments against re-optimizing existing accounts based on revenue, churn risk and automation upside.
Drive measurable outcomes on covered accounts: higher AI Agent automation rate, faster time to value, shorter custom action cycle time, and lower churn and contraction, with no drop in CSAT or resolution quality.

Run professional services as a business

Own the P&L of professional services: bookings, revenue, cost of delivery, utilization and gross margin. Set the targets and hit them.
Own pricing and packaging with Finance, Sales and RevOps: rate card, fixed price packages, statements of work and priced change requests. Protect margin by pushing back on waived fees and silent scope creep.
Enable the sales team. Train Account Executives to position, qualify, scope and sell professional services, and build the playbooks, pitch materials and qualification criteria they need. Partner with Product Marketing to take offers to market.
Enable the broader CX organization. Make Implementation Managers and CSMs self-sufficient on standard configurations, basic custom actions and first-line troubleshooting, so engineers stay focused on complex builds.

Build leverage

Productize the field. Every custom build has to make the next deployment cheaper: when we solve something for one merchant, it becomes a template, a reusable action, a playbook or a product update for the next 10. Track custom work per deployment and drive it down every quarter.
Automate the team’s own work. Use AI coding tools, agents and evals to speed up discovery, scoping, configuration, QA and reporting, so impact grows faster than headcount.
Be the voice of the enterprise merchant in Product and Engineering. Turn field signals into clear, prioritized requests and help shape the roadmap.
Represent Gorgias with leaders at enterprise brands, from strategy conversations to technical deep dives.

Who You Are

10+ years in solutions engineering, solutions architecture, forward deployed engineering, professional services or technical consulting, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
5+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, ideally both pre-sales and post-sales, with a record of hiring and growing strong engineers and managers.
A proven pre-sales leader. You have helped win complex six and seven figure enterprise deals, and you know how to run technical discovery, proofs of concept and mutual close plans alongside Sales.
A professional services operator. You have owned a services P&L or a large part of it: you have priced and packaged services, managed utilization and gross margin, and turned custom work into standard offers.
A transformation leader. You have taken a reactive technical team and built a scalable, productized deployment motion, and you show up with a plan rather than a list of blockers.
An AI builder. You have shipped LLM-powered agents, workflows or integrations into production and know how to test them with evals and real data. You can show us something you built recently.
Technical enough to do the work. You can write and review code in Python or JavaScript and TypeScript, and work with REST APIs, webhooks and SQL.
Commercially sharp. You connect technical work to revenue, retention and margin, and you can say no to scope that does not make sense.
Calm and clear with customers. As comfortable presenting to an enterprise COO as debugging with their engineers.
Energized by ambiguity. You like building a function, and you write down how it works so others can run it.

Nice to have

Ecommerce or CX tech experience: Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Magento, helpdesks, OMS or WMS platforms.
Experience at an AI customer service company or with conversational AI.
Experience leading teams across North America, Europe and Latin America.

Perks & Benefits

🏖️ 5-week vacation (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws)

🤕 Paid sick leave

🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

💻 MacBook or equivalent PC

🏥 Health insurance with Sunlife and RRSP matching with Wealthsimple

💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to $900 CAD to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy)

📚 Get up to $2600 CAD of learning material per year (includes books, courses, training sessions that are easily identified and linked with your job scope. This also covers individual coaching!)

🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Pivot est une startup québécoise qui simplifie la gestion des opérations pour les restaurants.
Adoptée par des restaurants gastronomiques et des chaînes comme A&W, Boustan et Poulet Rouge, notre plateforme aide les restaurateurs à gérer leurs horaires, leurs équipes, leurs pourboires et leur paie.

Notre ambition : éliminer les tâches répétitives pour permettre aux restaurateurs de se concentrer sur leur équipe et leurs clients.

Et on croit que l'IA change complètement la façon d'y arriver. Pas en ajoutant de l'IA aux fonctionnalités existantes, mais en repensant ce que le restaurateur devrait encore avoir à faire lui-même. C'est là que tu entres en jeu 🚀

Le rôle

Tu seras notre Head of Product : un team of one, responsable de bâtir le produit, mais aussi la fonction produit de Pivot. Tu travailleras directement avec nos deux fondateurs, qui portent la vision produit, tu relèveras de notre CTO et tu formeras un tandem avec notre Head of Engineering. Ceci est un poste hybride où vous vous joindrez au bureau trois jours par semaine (mardi, mercredi, jeudi).

Tes missions

Comprendre les problèmes qui comptent :
Aller à la rencontre des restaurateurs, remonter des demandes individuelles aux problèmes fondamentaux qu'elles révèlent et challenger les hypothèses, les leurs comme les nôtres.
Concevoir des produits AI-native :
Partir du résultat recherché plutôt que des interfaces existantes, et déterminer ce que la technologie peut prendre en charge et ce qui mérite réellement une intervention humaine.
Prototyper et valider rapidement :
Matérialiser les idées en prototypes, simulations et expérimentations, et les valider avec les clients avant d'investir en développement.
Roadmap et priorisation :
Bâtir une roadmap guidée par la valeur client et les priorités d'affaires, définir les MVP qui démontrent la valeur et décider ce qui mérite notre énergie maintenant.
Préparation pour l'ingénierie :
Avec le Head of Engineering, définir les grandes capacités nécessaires et leur séquencement, et t'assurer que les initiatives sont mûres avant le développement.
Mesure et itération :
Mesurer l'adoption et la valeur créée, puis ajuster les priorités selon les résultats plutôt que suivre un plan figé.
Bâtir la fonction produit :
Mettre en place une démarche légère de découverte, de conception et de validation. Pas de bureaucratie, pas de processus pour le plaisir d'avoir des processus.
Challenger la vision :
T'imprégner de la vision des fondateurs, l'enrichir avec ce que tu apprends sur le terrain et la challenger quand il le faut.

Tu dois être aussi à l'aise à discuter de stratégie avec les fondateurs qu'à passer une heure avec un restaurateur pour comprendre ce qui a mal tourné pendant son service du samedi soir.

Ton profil

Expérience solide en Product Management (PM senior, Lead PM ou Head of Product), idéalement en startup ou en SaaS.
Tu as déjà contribué à concevoir, lancer et commercialiser des produits numériques.
Tu utilises déjà intensivement l'IA dans ton travail : recherche, analyse, prototypage, automatisation.
Bonne compréhension des nouvelles possibilités de l'IA et de la façon de les appliquer à la conception produit.
Capacité à passer rapidement d'un problème à une hypothèse, à un prototype, puis à une validation client.
Excellent jugement d'affaires et capacité à faire des choix.
Assez à l'aise techniquement pour collaborer étroitement avec une équipe d'ingénierie.
Le leadership nécessaire pour challenger des fondateurs ambitieux et faire converger les décisions.
Autonomie, sens de l'organisation, et autant d'intérêt pour la stratégie que pour l'exécution.
À l'aise dans un environnement startup où les priorités évoluent et où ton travail a un impact direct.

Un vrai + si tu as de l'expérience en restauration, dans des produits intégrant l'IA ou en automatisation intelligente.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
